name: DeepSeek Harness
one_liner: Builds an agent harness where every capability is a plugin.

text.why: An agent harness gets heavier with every capability added, and features nobody asked for come along with them. DeepSeek Harness takes the position that everything is a plugin, so only what is needed gets attached. It is written in TypeScript, published under MIT, and documented on its own homepage. The repository description is a single line, so the supported scope has to be read from the docs.
text.take: One command brings up the web UI, but this is a developer preview: treat it as something to study, not adopt.
build: An in-house agent setup carrying only the capabilities you need
A shared set of internal plugins for the team

who.situation: wants to compose a harness from plugins
builds a shared plugin set for a team

start.text: The web UI opens at http://127.0.0.1:3080

caveat: A developer preview; the README states there will be breaking changes
